data.title: Evora Residences
data.about:
Evora Residences by Anax Developments is an exclusive collection of luxury apartments in the heart of Al Furjan. It offers a collection of 77 units, including 1 to 3-bedroom residences, ranging from 766.50 sq. ft. to 2,598.62 sq. ft.

The interiors boast branded Italian kitchens with appliances, high ceilings, and open layouts that create a seamless flow of space and light. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide breathtaking views and bathe your home in natural light. Every apartment is thoughtfully crafted to deliver invigorating freshness and revitalizing ambiance for a tranquil sanctuary you’ll love to live.

Set amidst a vibrant community, Evora Residences offers world-class amenities, including an infinity pool, a tranquil yoga room, a state-of-the-art gym, and dedicated play areas for children. Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience at Evora Residences Al Furjan.

characteristics_module.title: Evora Residences: Redefining Luxury, Connectivity, and Community Living in Al Furjan.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Strategic Location: Nestled in Al Furjan, connected to Sheikh Zayed Road and metro stations for seamless connectivity.
  • Luxury Living: Featuring fully-equipped 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with Italian finishes, smart home solutions, and premium interiors.
  • Captivating Views: Floor-to-ceiling windows offering serene views of green landscapes and vibrant community surroundings.
  • Well-Balanced Lifestyle: Close to parks, malls, schools, and healthcare centers for an all-encompassing community experience.
  • Unparalleled Design: Designed by EMDAC, Evora introduces a unique architectural style that enhances the character and appeal of the Al Furjan community.

location_tile.title: Evora: A Unique Addition to Al Furjan's Green, Family-Friendly Community
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Evora, a peaceful retreat nestled in the sprawling green oasis of Al Furjan, offers a perfect blend of suburban tranquility and urban convenience. Situated between Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Furjan provides seamless connectivity to key areas of Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Expo City. 

The vibrant community is renowned for its lush landscapes, well-planned infrastructure, and proximity to essential amenities such as schools, healthcare facilities, retail centers, and leisure destinations. Al Furjan's strategic location makes it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a serene yet connected lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.

  • 4 Minutes - Metro Station
  • 8 Minutes - Ibn Battuta Mall
  • 12 Minutes - Dubai Marina
  • 12 Minutes - Expo City Dubai
  • 14 Minutes - Jumeirah Beach Residences (JBR)
